cards.title: Multiple Dose Levels and Dose Normalization
cards.claim: Dose normalization requires an interpretable denominator (e.g., mg/kg). Salt vs. free base, active moiety, and administered mixture vs. measured component distinctions must be preserved. Normalization does not prove proportionality or linear disposition.
required_inputs: Concentration basis. Explicit link between administered entity (salt/free base, active moiety or mixture) and measured analyte/component.
cards.downstream_use: Dose-scaling assessment and human scenario preparation.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
